page.layout: One page of text. Above: a printed ornamental headpiece with a centred dedication title block (full width). Below: a salutation paragraph with a woodcut initial. At the foot: the signature mark and page number, centred right.

main_text.head: ILLVSTRI ET GENEROSO COMITI ET DOMINO, Dn. ARNOLDO, Comiti in Bentheim, Teclaburg, Steinfurt & Limpurg, Domino in Rheda, Weuelnghouen, Alpen & Helffenstein, L. Baroni in Lennep, &c. hæreditario Præfecto Colonia Agrippina, Domino suo clementissimo,
main_text.p: ANNVS iam agitur nonus, Illustris ac Generose Comes, Domine clementissime, ex quo ad Philosophiam in inclyto tuo Gymnasio Steinfurtensi profitendū nō sine singulari Dei prouidentia sum vocatus. Ab eo tempore nihil prætermisi, quod ad excolendā & illustrandam hanc facultatē, cui ab ineūte ætate deditus fui, pertinere videbatur. Idq; feci nō tantum, quod vocationis suscepta ratio hoc à me postu-

page.notes: The woodcut initial "A" is joined to "NNVS" as "ANNVS". The title block is set in large capitals and roman type; the lines of the salutation and the first paragraph alternate between italic and roman, and the italic/roman boundaries in the middle lines are uncertain, so they are marked by impression only. The "c" mark at top right and the pale catch-mark at the right edge are not printed text and are omitted. The "S.D." greeting is set as its own paragraph per the letter rules. "inclyto" and "tempore" are read from the scan without certainty about the exact diacritics; "tĕpore" and similar small marks are normalised. No margin notes are present.
